chunks: Abu al-Maghra' Humayd ibn al-Muthanna said: I was with Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, and Hafs al-Kalbi asked him and said:
When I am behind the Imam while he recites aloud, may I make du'a and seek refuge?

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam leading the congregational salat
key_terms.فَأَدْعُو: so I make du'a or supplicate
key_terms.وَأَتَعَوَّذُ: and I seek refuge in Allah

ai.seo_question: Can I make du'a while praying behind the Imam during audible recitation?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a person praying behind the Imam during audible recitation may engage in du'a and seeking refuge. It indicates a practical ruling related to congregational salat and the permissible forms of worship for the follower while listening to the Imam.
